content.text:
Ball1 starts 0.8 m above hoop1, falls through it, and strikes flap1. Flap1 swings, freeing the block, which falls onto flap2. Flap2 swings and frees ball2; ball2 passes through hoop2 and settles in the cup below 5 cm/s.

However, both flaps finish at their **upper joint limits**, not their lower stops, and their last retaining-cam contacts end before those limits are reached. The revision below reverses the hinge coordinates and extends the retaining cams to delay release until terminal-stop engagement. It has not been re-simulated here.
